NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of 1974,I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of the immovableproperty, shown in the following schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, for theconstruction of Access Road to the Water Storage Tank with a capacity 450 cubic meters under the Ruwanwella WaterSupply Scheme.

RAUFF HAKEEM,Minister of City Planning andWater Supply.Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply,No. 35, ‘Lakdiya Medura’,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,01st December, 2016.5/2/1/1199SCHEDULE

An allotment of land called Peterhill States situated at Siybalawala village in Grama Niladhari Division ofSiybalawala, 100B in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ruwanwella in Kegalle District and in total extent of about 10.3perches and bounded follows :—

North by:Peterhill watta land claimed by Mrs. B. Dharmalatha and Pradeshiya Sabha Road.East by:Remaining portion of the same land ;South by:Peterhill watta land claimed by Mr. K. K. Amarasinghe and remaining portion of the sameland ;West by:Peterhill watta land claimed by Mrs B. Dharmalatha.
Name and address of the claimant of the land :01.Mrs. B. Darmalatha,Dahamsiri Mawatha,Siyabalawala,Imbulana.12- 962
